answer:
The normal resting heart rate for most adults is **60–100 beats per minute (bpm)**, measured after sitting quietly [MedlinePlus, 2023]. Well-conditioned athletes may have a lower resting heart rate, sometimes **40–60 bpm** [MedlinePlus, 2023]. A rate consistently outside 60–100 bpm at rest, especially with symptoms like dizziness or chest discomfort, warrants medical evaluation [MedlinePlus, 2023]. 

This information is derived from general health guidelines and should be reviewed by a healthcare professional for individualized assessment. 

**Source:** Understanding Your Heart Rate, MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), 2023 [https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003399.htm](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003399.htm)
